posts.name: Trajector
posts.cooked:
Just listened to this episode this morning, and its poignancy really got to me.

Christopher and Adam, I want to offer you my sincere congratulations. Getting to take something you love and make it into your career, especially with people you love, is a monumental achievement. It’s something that few get to do. Loads of people get to be successful at what they do, and get advancement and reward as a result - but doing something that you truly enjoy and fundamentally care about, day-in and day-out, is really special. You got a good dose of luck, and you obviously put sweat and tears into your efforts, and I want to congratulate you on where you made it to today. It’s incredibly impressive.

Happy New Year!
